The '''Narrant system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to a number of liege-holder clans, which were loose confederations of genetically-linked [[Species/Legends|species]], with complex layers of ritual obeisance and [[Blood/Legends|blood]] oaths maintaining their unity. The [[Lyunesi]] [[Oph Nar Dinnid]] worked as a [[comm handler]] for one of the clan's supreme [[liege-lord]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>
